name: Istanbul
tagline: Ottoman cuisine with a Michelin star inside the Spice Bazaar, since 1901.

Pandeli.description: Ottoman cuisine inside the Grand Spice Bazaar since 1901. Michelin star, reviewed by critic Manos Angelakis (LuxuryWeb Magazine).

Tatbak.description: Istanbul's benchmark kebab since 1960, with spicy Gaziantep-style lahmacun.

Tarihi Karaköy Balıkçısı.description: A historic fish restaurant in Karaköy, serving since 1923 at the entrance to Griffin Han.

Kızılkayalar.description: The Beyoğlu spot behind the islak hamburger (wet burger) that Anthony Bourdain tried on "No Reservations": "Why on earth do Turks go to McDonald's when they have this?"

Sofyalı 9.description: One of Beyoğlu's most established traditional meyhanes, with mezze and raki near Tünel.
